top_signals.title: US Stock Futures Extend Gains, Brent Crude Drops: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US stock-index futures rose and Asian shares erased their losses, indicating a drop in technology shares on speculation about OpenAI’s revenue may be brief. Crude oil fell.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: The EU budget continues delivering for Europe in 2025
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 08 Oct 2026 Today, the Court of Auditors (ECA) published its Annual Report, giving the EU's annual accounts a clean bill of health for the 19th consecutive year. The ECA confirmed that the collection of EU revenues was free from material error.
